To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Military service records for subject below;
Name: William S. Bentley
Branch: United States Navy
DOB - July 27, 1940
Dates of Service: Approx yrs 1959 to 1979

Request following documents;
1) copy of Bronze Star medal award citations
2) copy of Navy Commendation Medal award citations
3) History of assignments form NAVPERS 601-5
4) copy of Navy achievement medal citations 
5) Training/Service Schools attended form NAVPERS 601-4
6) list of awards, date of release from Active Duty, badges
7) Purple heart administrative remarks 
8) Presidential unit citation award citation
Vietnam War
Redact per 5 U.S.C. § 552(b)(6).
I request hard copies of paperwork in the file showing this information.
Please mail hardcopies to:
MUCKROCK NEWS 
Dept MR#
263 HUNTINGTON AVE
BOSTON, MA 02115

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Eric Bradley

communications.subject: South Carolina Public Records Law Request: Personnel File
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the South Carolina Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

Dear Berkeley County:

In accordance with the South Carolina Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), S.C. Code Ann. § 30-4-10, et seq., Persons have the right to inspect, copy, or receive non-exempt Public Records.

I hereby request a copy of the complete Berkeley County Sheriff's Office personnel file for Deputy/Officer Rafeal R. Jones, including but not limited to the following: training records, disciplinary records, internal affairs investigation records, excessive force complaints, and departmental demotions, promotions, and transfers.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 15 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Sheila Turnball
